about: Known answers for the GALC v2 capsule: the preimage the genesis keys sign, the checkpoint hashes and epoch commitments of the proofs of K and K-1 it binds, one accepted capsule in its wire form, and capsules each accepted or refused for one named reason. Checked by the app (__tests__/GalcCapsule.test.js) and, with the node release, by the node.
testKeys: TEST KEYS. The five genesis keys and the outsider key below are made from labels (ML-DSA-65 key generation from SHA3-256 of "qnet-galc-capsule-v2/test-key/" + id); they are not the keys QNet Blockchain embeds, and no capsule here verifies under those. networkId is a label too, not the hash of block 0.
encodings: Hashes are lowercase hex. Signatures are consensus signature strings, "dilithium_sig_<id>_" + base64 of [u32 LE length][ML-DSA-65 signature, 3309 bytes, deterministic, empty context][the preimage][u32 LE 1952][public key]; the compact form ends after the preimage. A case lists each signature by its name in `signatures`; `capsule` is the first case in the wire form. Case roots default to `roots`.
